spec.name: whole-skill-delivery
spec.intent:
Census: complete-persona-launch of plan persona-owned-enforcement, source commit a327bd6e96f3c92d1dba0242bf886e6abc094cda. The line at d8701e45 changes only planning/design/notebook records relative to that source; the original source census still applies. The prior implementer's isolated edits are unaccepted and are not a baseline. Use a fresh isolated checkout off the line after predecessors are whole. Do not run builds/tests/linters/formatters mid-flight; main/integrator verifies the coherent unit against only its criteria. No design changes or rubric redesign are authorized.

Realize only the whole composed-skill obligation of skill routing on the two supported main-session paths. Retain the existing resolved-plugin skill roster and breadth-first deduplicated skillClosure semantics, including same-name plugin override and runtime capability routes. Deliver the entire closure before the first turn, not previews or promises to read it later. Claude's main-sessionSkillHook/oversizedSkills path currently turns an over-cap body into deferred required reading; replace that incomplete path with whole delivery using an available native carrier. omp's launcher likewise must not successfully call an incomplete composition complete after a failed skill read or incompatible skill-filter override. Choose explicit diagnostics/refusal for a missing required deployed body rather than silent fallback; do not weaken the complete positive path. Keep subagent preload correct and avoid double injection.

The implementation owns the preload/skill-bearing prompt carrier and its existing launcher callsites, not enforcement policy, per-persona guard filenames, consent UI or persona residue. Preserve the predecessor's selected scope/guards while changing skill delivery. Prefer an existing native full-body/file carrier, and use the already declared Claude persona-launch helper rather than inventing another generic runtime capability. If a new production helper is essential, route its concrete path to the planner before editing. Remove obsolete cap/deferred-reading exports, fields and callers as part of the cutover, not as compatibility aliases. Update skill-related docs and a changeset. Native flag help and existing launcher-shell/SessionStart-command tests provide the implementation boundary; tests must execute the emitted carrier and compare the full bytes. Final native ownership-plus-skills launch evidence belongs to the dependent persona-launch unit, not repeated here.

Execution substrate: the note omp isolation clone is not a plan-line worktree records an observed landing failure, not an optional convention. The required unit worktree is based on the current plan/persona-owned-enforcement tip and shares the Git common directory of the repository owning /home/lex/workspaces/cratylus.plan-persona-owned-enforcement. An automatic omp isolated clone is its own main checkout and may retain misleading external worktree metadata; it is not sufficient merely because plan show reads the right records. Establish the actual unit-worktree provenance before building, keep native automatic apply disabled, and record the landing in the owning repository. No implementation on the main checkout or directly on the integration line is authorized; no Git procedure or product change is prescribed here.
accept: Execute emitted main-session carriers for claude and omp against a diamond skill closure and compare every body and runtime route in full, exactly once and in closure order, before the captured first-turn input. Include a body beyond the old Claude hook cap, multibyte content, a long home path, and a later plugin override. Print each harness and closure denominator; the current over-cap deferred-reading implementation must fail.

A missing required body and an incompatible explicit skill filter cannot silently yield a successful complete launch; they produce an actionable diagnostic and no falsely complete first-turn input. Subagent skill preload does not duplicate the new main-session path. Existing selected enforcement scope and model-route arguments remain intact.

Retired cap/deferred-reading fields, exports and callsites are removed, related fixture expectations are migrated, and supported positive paths deliver whole bodies without truncation or runtime prompt scaffolding. Focused skill/launcher/closure tests and existing type checks suffice; no worker rubric or install-consent retest is added to this unit.
